lines.zh: 我踩在泥里，几乎没有声
lines.en: I tread the mud almost silently

lines.zh: 沼泽的水盖过我的脚踝
lines.en: The swamp water covers my ankles
My bones sound muffled in the damp
Step by step, I go around the pools

lines.zh: 藻从我的肋骨间垂下来
lines.en: Algae hangs from between my ribs
I move along the edge of the reeds
My prints in the mud are faint

lines.zh: 水汽让我身上的骨头变软
lines.en: The damp softens the bones on me
The water clouds where I pass
I crush duckweed, one halting step at a time.

lines.zh: 前面有脚步声，我加快了
lines.en: Steps ahead, so I hurry a little
I step on dead twigs and they do not snap
I stand in the shallows without moving
Moss has climbed to my knees

lines.zh: 我不呼吸，所以水面很平
lines.en: I do not breathe, so the water stays flat

lines.zh: 沼泽的雾把我遮住一半
lines.en: The swamp fog hides half of me
I wait for something to walk past
My fingers are the wrong length

lines.zh: 水里有东西碰了我一下
lines.en: Something in the water touched me
I tilt my head and listen
The green on my bones was grown by water
It is quiet here but for insects
I lift one foot slowly
The mud pulls me down a little

lines.zh: 我一直站在同一个坑里
lines.en: I have stood in this same hollow all along
The fog thins a little, it matters not
You walked into the swamp too
These bones are very old

lines.zh: 我站在这里等了一会儿
lines.en: I have stood here waiting a while
The mud under you is soft
There is me in the water, and other things

lines.zh: 你踩进水洼的时候我就看见了
lines.en: I saw you the moment you stepped in the pool
The green on me is not sickness
Do not back up, the water is worse
My face has no skin
You are looking at my ribs
The reeds are taller than I, they will not hide you
Did you hear the frogs stop
A stretch of shallow water lies between us
I do not shout, I only walk
The mud here will suck at your feet

lines.zh: 你的心跳在沼泽里很响。
lines.en: Your heartbeat is loud in the marsh.
My skull shows pale in the fog
You press your chest, I saw it
One of my bones came loose
I retreat into the muddy water
The water muffles my sound
My collarbone snaps in two.
I shudder and clumps of mud fall off
I do not cry out, I cannot
My arm hangs crooked
I will have to pick that up and reattach it
Broken bones can be rejoined
I straighten up slowly
I do not eat these
Things in the mud suit me better
Set it down, I will not take it
That will rot in the water
I smell it, it is iron

lines.zh: 你手上的东西我不需要
lines.en: I have no need of what you hold
Leave it, I will find my own
I only need you to stop moving

lines.zh: 沼泽里什么都有，就是没有礼物
lines.en: The swamp has everything but gifts
Hold it away, do not drip it in the water
You hit my ribs

lines.zh: 我退了半步，水响了一声
lines.en: I shift back and the water sloshes
Bones strike hard

lines.zh: 沼泽的泥里，我泡得发软。
lines.en: Swamp mud soaked me soft.
The muck makes this step slick
I steady myself on the reeds
We are very close now
Do not step back
Sounds carry far over water
Now we are both wet

lines.zh: 沼泽里还有别的骨头在走
lines.en: Other bones walk this swamp
When kin meet, we stop first
Walking together, the mud is easier

lines.zh: 我们不说话，只用骨头响
lines.en: We do not speak, we clack our bones
Two shadows on the water

lines.zh: 这段路有人陪着，也不坏
lines.en: This path is not bad with company

lines.zh: 我在芦苇丛里遇过一次
lines.en: I met one once among the reeds
We sink into the shallows together

lines.zh: 沼泽够大，两个也站得下
lines.en: The swamp is big enough for two
Neither of us hurries the other
I pinch it with my long fingers
It slips between my bones
Whatever I pick up comes with mud
This fell into the water
I raise it up to look
Wet things are heavy
I tuck it between my ribs
Things dropped end up in the water
This is no use to me either
I put it back on the bank
The water moved, so it is you
I have watched you from behind the reeds
This mire is mine
You walked into my hollow

lines.zh: 芦苇晃了一下，我看见了。
lines.en: The reeds sway once; I see it.
Muddy water runs off my legs.
There is no one else in the water
You are stuck in the mud
I can reach you without running
I alone know the paths here
I just measured this distance

lines.zh: 你的脚步声在水上很响
lines.en: Your steps ring loud on the water
I start toward you
The swamp will slow you down
Look back and you will see only reeds
The fog keeps a little between us
Step by step, and the water sounds
The way you are going is stagnant water
I know these reeds
My legs are slow in the mud
The faster you go, the deeper you sink
I move along the surface of the water

lines.zh: 枯枝的响声还在水上传。
lines.en: The snap of the branch still travels the water.
The fog stretches your shadow
Even the water insects have gone quiet
A few more steps and it is deep water
I am behind you, not ahead
Your boots are soaked through
I stop and listen once
The mud here grips tightly
I slowly close my fingers
Water runs between my ribs.
The muddy water parts at my feet

lines.zh: 你的影子在水面上发抖
lines.en: Your shadow trembles on the water
My long fingers clamp on you
Bone drags across skin
That came with mud and water
I hit you with my shoulder
You are pressed into the shallows

lines.zh: 我的手腕很细，可很有力
lines.en: My wrist is thin, but strong
That grab left a wet handprint
Water splashes up
I pull at your collar
You are still standing, not bad
That was slow, and you did not dodge

lines.zh: 泥从我的指缝里挤出来
lines.en: Mud squeezes between my fingers
I draw back, and my bones creak

lines.zh: 你身上留下了绿的痕迹
lines.en: A green mark is left on you
A second one would go deeper
Shallow water makes standing hard
I rise up out of the mud
A length of bone surfaces
This swamp has one more of us
I rise up out of the mud.
The reeds part around me

lines.zh: 我站的位置本来就是烂泥
lines.en: Where I stand was already muck
When the fog thickens, I come out
My bones creak, slowly

lines.zh: 沼泽里走了很久的那个就是我
lines.en: The one who has walked this swamp so long is me

lines.zh: 我抬起头，从泥里找出你
lines.en: I raise my head and find you in the muck
Water drips off me
This water is not strange to me
My feet sink into the mud, steady
A shape appears in the fog
I head toward the sound
The insects here have hidden
I come out of the deep reeds

lines.zh: 骨头撞在一起，响了一声
lines.en: My bones knock together once
White steam rises off my wet bones
I drop from above into the water
Water climbs over my skull
Mud and water both blown apart

lines.zh: 飞来的东西卡在我肋骨上
lines.en: Something flying sticks between my ribs

lines.zh: 那股力把我的骨头拉散了
lines.en: That force pulled my bones apart

lines.zh: 沼泽没东西吃，我越来越空
lines.en: Nothing to eat here, I grow emptier

lines.zh: 雷落到沼泽上，我全身发亮
lines.en: Lightning hits the swamp and I light up

lines.zh: 虚空里没有泥，也没有水
lines.en: No mud and no water in the void
